receipt.composition: Composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies
setup.composition.note: Tick this if your GSTIN is under the composition scheme: you cannot collect GST, so bills print as a 'Bill of Supply' with your GSTIN and the composition line
setup.prefix.returning: Used Angadi before on another phone or install? Choose a new prefix (e.g. B) so bill numbers never repeat
bill.void.pastmonth: This bill is from an earlier month. Cancelling it changes that month's GST summary, which you may already have filed. Cancel it anyway?
